name: Joseph Hanauer
role: Glendive businessman; partner in Martindale & Hanauer
bio: Joseph Hanauer was a partner in the store of Martindale & Hanauer, which the paper said was doing a big business in August 1884. He came from Glendive to Medora on business in September 1885 and to visit in May 1886.

moments.label: Martindale & Hanauer store reported doing brisk trade

mentions: The new store of Martindale & Hanauer is doing a land office business, and the proprietors are pre-eminently popular.
Jos. Hanauer, of Glendive, made a business trip to Medora, Tuesday.
J. H. Gordon and wife and Joseph Hanauer of Glendive, were here Sunday, on a visit to T. W. Gordon.
